      ∀ (I : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Instance p.d)
        (O :

            (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p))

        outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.admissible p I O →
          let q :=
            have __src := outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p;
            { d := __src.d, n := __src.n, gamma := __src.gamma, R := __src.R, x0 := __src.x0, K := K };
          outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.successful p I
            (fun z =>
              OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning.ringmasterPoint q) (fun x => K) z.1 z.2)
            ⟨(↑((outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning.ringmasterPoint q).law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1), ⋯⟩

declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params),
  (0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ ∀ (i : Fin p.n), OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i)) →
    ∀ (I : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Instance p.d)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle
          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))),
      outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O →
        OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
              (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ <
            ⊤ →
          let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p;
          outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
            (fun z =>
              OracleTemplate.execute O (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q)
                (fun x => outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning.timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
            ⟨(↑((OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q).law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1), ⋯⟩
